title: The Orchard of Calculated Growth

features.name: root that computes
features.desc-on-touch: A thick root surfacing, but each rootlet branches like a circuit trace. You can't tell if it's thinking or growing.

features.name: algorithmic canopy
features.desc-on-touch: The leaves arrange themselves in recursing patterns. Each tier computes the next. The orchard grows itself according to rules that taste like sunlight.

features.name: fruit of the recursion
features.desc-on-touch: Something hanging between an apple and a node. Biting it would return a sequence. Planting it would grow another orchard inside itself.

features.name: the grove's own map
features.desc-on-touch: A chart of itself growing on a bark plate. The map updates as you read it. You are the latest entry.

features.name: signal trees
features.desc-on-touch: Certain trees stand motionless, antennas wound into their timber. They listen to the growth happening around them and add it to their rings.

inscription: every root learns to branch like a thought, every thought here grows fruit

file.name: Orchard_Growth_Coefficients_Seasonal.txt
file.note: The algorithm the trees taught the board, or the board taught itself through the trees. The distinction does not survive reading it.

exits.label: back to the board and its ungrowing roots
deeper into the grove where trees grow downward into thought
toward other groves where calculation learned to bear fruit
